core: Apical epithelial membrane protein and lipid transport
qualifier: hepatobiliary lipid translocation and bile secretion
name: Apical epithelial membrane transport with hepatobiliary lipid translocation
rationale: Members concern polarized apical/raft protein localization, CFTR and phospholipid flipping in epithelia; bile acid secretion, ABCB4/ABCB11 defects, sphingolipid translocation and microvillus assembly distinguish it from the flippase/Golgi-export confusables.

core: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development
name: Peripheral sensory, sympathetic and cranial nerve neuron development
rationale: All members concern development, migration and axon outgrowth of DRG, sympathetic and trigeminal/facial (branchiomotor) neurons, unlike confusables centred on CNS monoaminergic axon guidance or brainstem/hindbrain maturation.

name: Phagosome maturation and its subversion by Mycobacterium tuberculosis
rationale: Members cover phagosome/endosome acidification and phagolysosome fusion plus Mtb blockade of these and of host apoptosis, autophagy and NO, distinguishing it from Mtb iron acquisition and other pathogen/toxin entry confusables.

name: Filopodium assembly and actin-based cell shape control
rationale: Members regulate filopodia and actin-driven cell shape (RHOF cycle, EPHB forward signaling, postsynaptic actin), unlike confusables about actin severing, ephrin repulsion or dendrite arborization.

name: Endocardium and trabecular myocardium formation with coronary vasculogenesis
rationale: Members concern endocardium differentiation, ventricular trabeculation and coronary vascular/smooth muscle development, whereas confusables cover compact myocardium, septation and general cardiogenesis.

name: Bicarbonate and SLC26 anion exchange in acid-base balance
rationale: Members are SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate exchangers, their diseases and CO2 hydration/pH control, unlike confusables about phosphate transport or organelle lumen acidification.

name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment and endocytic entry into host cells
rationale: All members concern virion attachment, endocytic uptake and positive regulation of viral entry, generic across viruses, unlike virus-specific (dengue, RSV) life-cycle or host-restriction confusables.

qualifier: myoblast fusion and satellite cell regeneration
name: Skeletal myoblast differentiation, fusion and satellite cell-driven regeneration
rationale: Members regulate myoblast proliferation, differentiation, fusion and satellite cell activation in skeletal muscle, unlike confusables about muscle atrophy, cardiac muscle growth or specific muscle development.

name: Pain, itch and thermal sensing via TRP channels and tachykinins
rationale: Members cover detection of noxious mechanical, thermal and acid stimuli, itch and fever with TRP channels and tachykinin receptors, distinguishing it from two-pore potassium channel and taste/smell confusables.

name: LDL receptor-family degradation limiting lipoprotein uptake
rationale: Members concern LDLR/VLDLR turnover and LXR-driven limitation of LDL clearance, unlike confusables on lipoprotein assembly/remodeling, sterol sensing or cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: chylomicron and VLDL assembly, lipolysis and clearance
name: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly, lipolysis and clearance
rationale: Members follow dietary lipid absorption, chylomicron/VLDL assembly, lipase-mediated remodeling and clearance, unlike confusables focused on LDL/HDL remodeling or phospholipid catabolism.

qualifier: glutamate and aspartate plasma membrane uptake
name: Glutamate, aspartate and GABA reuptake and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern excitatory amino acid transporter uptake of glutamate/aspartate, GABA import and synthesis and astrocytic glutamate handling, unlike confusables on vesicular loading, glycinergic or monoamine transmission.

qualifier: fusions, amplifications and ALK inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and ALK inhibitor-resistant mutants
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, LTK and ALK fusion, amplification and drug-resistant mutant signaling, with ALK TKI resistance and FGFR fusions distinguishing it from KIT, FLT3-TKI and EGFR/ERBB2 confusables.

core: p53 activation in DNA damage response
qualifier: p53 stability control and ARF loss
name: p53 stability control, ARF loss and DNA damage-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members concern p53 phosphorylation/degradation, p14ARF and TP53 defects, and p53-mediated apoptosis and G2/M checkpoint control, unlike confusables on p53 transcription of p21/G1 arrest or radiation responses.

name: Oligodendrocyte development and central nervous system myelination
rationale: Members cover oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, CNS myelin formation and maintenance and glial responses, unlike confusables on Schwann cell myelination, nodes or axon regeneration.

name: Cyclooxygenase-mediated prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis
rationale: All members describe COX conversion of arachidonate to prostaglandins and thromboxanes, unlike confusables on prostaglandin secretion regulation or prostanoid receptors.

name: RET-GDNF and endothelin signaling in enteric neural crest development
rationale: Members combine GDNF/RET and endothelin receptor signaling with neural crest migration and enteric/midgut development, unlike confusables on gut motility, adrenal or blood pressure.

name: Hedgehog N-terminal palmitoylation and ligand release
rationale: Members concern N-terminal lipidation of Hedgehog by HHAT and release of lipidated Hh, unlike Wnt, GPI-anchor, Notch glycosylation or Hh autoprocessing confusables.

qualifier: GDP-mannose and dolichol phosphate enzyme defects
name: GDP-mannose and dolichol phosphate synthesis in congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and PMM2, MPI, PGM1 and DOLK defects, unlike confusables centred on DPM synthase or downstream glycan CDGs.

qualifier: NAD salvage, phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: NAD salvage, phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members concern pyridine nucleotide salvage and transport, creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide carriers (targeted in virus-induced apoptosis), unlike confusables on nucleotide interconversion or tryptophan-derived NAD.

name: Reelin-driven synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members combine reelin signaling with LTP/LTD, synapse maturation, spine maintenance and memory, unlike confusables on dendrite arborization, synaptic transmission or amyloid/tau formation.

name: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in monocyte and macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members cover M-CSF, GM-CSF and G-CSF production and signaling driving monocyte, macrophage and myeloid DC differentiation, unlike DAP12, SIRP or IL-6 confusables.

name: Late mitotic cytokinesis and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing
rationale: Members cover spindle midzone, contractile ring, septins, midbody abscission and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing, unlike confusables on chromosome cohesion/condensation or nuclear envelope breakdown.

name: Netrin signaling in axon chemorepulsion and extension control
rationale: Members concern netrin signaling with chemorepulsion and regulation of axon extension during guidance, unlike semaphorin, ephrin/L1 or neuron-type-specific guidance confusables.

qualifier: AMPA receptor clustering and diffusion trapping
name: AMPA receptor clustering and postsynaptic trapping in excitatory transmission
rationale: Members concern glutamate/AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and short-term plasticity, unlike confusables on kainate/presynaptic modulation or NMDA receptor signaling.
